verdict.rationale: Graphite documents an official MCP server, GT MCP, at its own docs page. It lets AI agents automatically create stacked PRs, and MCP is listed as an included feature on the pricing page, so an agent can connect through a first-party MCP server. Missing for 10: documented setup and connection steps, an enumerated tool list or scope beyond stacked-PR creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: GT MCP allows AI agents to automatically create stacked PRs, breaking down large AI-generated changes into smaller, reviewable stacked pull requests.
official MCP server documented at https://graphite.com/docs/gt-mcp
CLI for stacked PRs and simplified git commands ... MCP ... VSCode extension
